description: The morning-briefing relay presented the DRC MarketScale video shoot as an item on David's watch list ('still waiting on room audio/lavalier and a room picture from DRC's Olivia. If that room picture doesn't show up today, the shoot improvises'), implying David needed to chase it. David corrected: the shoot is a delegation, the other party is handling it, not him.
correction: Before flagging a workstream as David's follow-up, check ownership: if the work is delegated or owned by another party, present it as delegation status, not as David's action item. Delegation-aware briefing, not ownership-blind flagging.
systemic_fix: Briefing follow-up lists must distinguish three states: David's action item, delegated (owner named, tracked), and other party's obligation (not David's to chase). When ownership is unknown, say so instead of defaulting it to David.
